note: Illinois DNR fish and wildlife area around 2,400-acre Horseshoe Lake, a shallow cypress-tupelo oxbow near Miller City and Olive Branch, 7 miles north of Cairo. Three camping areas: the Class A campground with showers on the west side, under trees beside a narrow cypress channel; the Class B/E campground on the east shore off Route 3 (this pin); and a small Class C area on West Side Drive. A camp host is on site. --Claude
